versions.changelog:
- Added a YAML front matter section with an updated tool description, including use cases and Chinese keywords for localization.
- Expanded the description to highlight capabilities in campaign localization and adapting visuals for different markets.
- No changes to core functionality or usage; documentation improvement only.

- Added a new README.md file.
- Updated SKILL.md with a new upgrade URL (https://mediaclawbot.com).

- Initial release of Brand Video Maker.
- Seamlessly replaces logos, product packaging, text overlays, and brand colors in any video.
- Utilizes AI inpainting and image-to-video generation for perspective-correct, high-quality edits.
- Maintains original footage quality, including reflections, shadows, and material details.
- Supports batch processing for multiple videos with consistent branding.
- Ideal for white-label content, product placement, localization, and A/B testing of brand elements.
